description:
A tray recorder that uploads to your own Google Drive and transcribes on the device or with your own API key.

Recly is a system tray recorder. It records the microphone and system audio as separate tracks, and when a meeting app starts using the microphone it asks whether to record.
Recordings are uploaded to your own Google Drive. There is no Recly server and no Recly account.
Transcription runs on the device with the open-source Qwen3-ASR 0.6B model through sherpa-onnx (64-bit Windows with at least 6 GiB of memory; a one-time model download of about 1 GB), or through a transcription service with your own API key.
